title: thymus serpyllum f. orbicularis
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. orbicularis, commonly known as creeping thyme, is a low-growing, spreading herbaceous perennial plant belonging to the mint family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory infections, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to relax and soothe, as well as its antioxidant and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum f. orbicularis include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
